entries.subject: Thomas et al. Methone measured ellipsoid
entries.finding: The measured axes and PCK00011 BODY632_RADII support the analytic ellipsoid, which is not a detailed terrain mesh.

entries.subject: Cassini N1716192103 clear-filter view
entries.finding: The May 2012 calibrated image supplies the coarse Monochrome view. Its limb/terminator fit is pointing evidence, not independent feature registration.

entries.subject: Other Methone clear-filter frames
entries.finding: Other 2012 frames cover similar longitudes and the next independent encounter is about one pixel across the body, so they do not add a useful qualified patch.
entries.revisitWhen: A distinct resolved view with useful coverage and controlled geometry can be projected.

entries.subject: Methone UV, green and infrared route
entries.finding: Surveyed complementary frames did not establish a significant UV/IR-ratio correlation with the oval, so no color or composition dataset is claimed.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered multispectral product with reproducible spatial signal can support a dataset.

entries.subject: Updated Methone shape and corrected-map route
entries.finding: The LPSC corrected map remains a comparison rather than a substitute for calibrated pixels; the newer shape survey was inspected but full text was unavailable.
entries.revisitWhen: A released full study or body-specific local-elevation product can be assessed.
